svg.title: A large tilt overturns the pencil
svg.desc: A pencil on its flat end tilts beyond the point where its center of gravity lies above the pivot. The weight acts to the left of the pivot and produces counterclockwise torque, increasing the tilt. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Tipping starts when the center of mass passes the support edge
The tilt is imposed for comparison; this is not a free-fall timing model.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
